deployments_detail.use: Nomad: AI-powered comms-intelligence device (clean/transcribe/translate/analyse voice+text in real time) launched at DSEI 2025

Nomad - an AI-powered communications intelligence device that cleans, transcribes, translates and analyses voice and text data in real time at the tactical edge (operates offline in communications-denied environments), for military/security services [Babcock in-house (Mission Systems)]

Metis digital asset management and intelligence platform - uses AI to give a connected view of asset reliability, availability and readiness across the lifecycle; deployed with the British Army under the Service Provision and Transformation Contract managing 30,000+ vehicles [Babcock in-house]
deployments_detail.value: manages more than 30,000 vehicles for the British Army

deployments_detail.use: Babcock-developed machine-learning algorithm that localises and quantifies corrosion and paint blistering (using Aruco markers on ROV surveys of flooded/underwater spaces) and produces an automated digital survey report [Babcock in-house]

Palantir Warp Speed manufacturing operating system integrated into warship build/through-life support (starting with the Arrowhead 140 frigate at Rosyth) - predictive support, real-time production visibility, bottleneck/risk prediction across schedules, workflows and supplier data [Palantir Technologies (Warp Speed)]

Machine-learning driven predictive support simulation and optimization tool for complex fleets (Babcock Canada) - optimizes aircraft, resource and inventory allocation while minimizing cost and maintaining compliance [Larus (AI/ML solutions provider)]

Supply Chain Planning Tool using digital-twin and agent-based simulation for the British Army's Equipment Support - 'what-if' scenario analysis and stress-testing of readiness, sustainment and regeneration (modelling supply loss, combat attrition); integrated with Babcock's Metis [Skyral]

Enterprise-wide Palantir Foundry data platform for defence - transforming, capturing, integrating, modelling and building data-driven solutions; Palantir usage growing across Babcock's data application estate and used in graduate/data analytics programmes [Palantir Technologies UK (Foundry)]

Digital engineering transformation on Dassault Systemes 3DEXPERIENCE platform - AI-powered science-based virtual/digital twins to simulate and validate systems across shipbuilding, submarine support, nuclear and aviation programmes [Dassault Systemes (3DEXPERIENCE)]
